title: SkyS3
description: SkyS3 cluster health: flush backlog and loss exposure, replication, conflicts, placement, control store, erasure-coding repair and reclamation, caches, and transport. Metrics: docs/skys3-metrics.md.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Nodes whose admin listener answers scrapes (SkyS3NodeDown).

panels.title: Coordinators
panels.description: Nodes acting as coordinator; exactly one is healthy (SkyS3CoordinatorMissing).

panels.title: Disks out of service
panels.description: Disks an I/O error took out of service (SkyS3DiskOutOfService).

panels.title: Unsatisfied placement policies
panels.description: Buckets whose placement policy the cluster does not satisfy (SkyS3PlacementPolicyUnsatisfied).

panels.title: Oldest dirty age
panels.description: Age of the oldest change not yet at the remote target, per bucket: the loss exposure (design section 7.6).

panels.title: Flush lag
panels.description: Age of the oldest change the flushers still work on, without held conflicts. Growing lag means flushing does not keep up.

panels.title: Dirty bytes
panels.description: Bytes of committed versions not yet at the remote target, per bucket.

panels.title: Dirty budget used
panels.description: Each node's dirty bytes over its share of the bucket's budget; at 1 new writes get 503 SlowDown.

panels.title: Flushes
panels.description: Versions and server-side copies flushed per second, and copies that fell back to an upload.

panels.title: Flush retries and write refusals
panels.description: Flush attempts retried, and writes admission control refused, per second.

panels.title: Orphaned remote uploads
panels.description: Remote multipart uploads left open that later flushes will abort.

panels.title: Streaming overlap
panels.description: Median and 10th percentile of the bytes a streamed multipart upload had at the remote when the client completed it.

panels.title: Under-replicated bytes
panels.description: Bytes held by shards with fewer members than their replicas setting, counted on their primaries (design section 6.4).

panels.title: Oldest under-replicated age
panels.description: How long the longest under-replicated shard has been short of members: the durability window.

panels.title: Nodes answering
panels.description: Scrape health per node; a node that does not answer has lost its leases and its shards fail over.

panels.title: Coordinator
panels.description: Which node is coordinator (1); placement work moves with the lease.

panels.title: Keys held in conflict
panels.description: Keys the hold policy keeps until an operator resolves them (SkyS3ConflictsHeld).

panels.title: Conflicts found and resolved
panels.description: Out-of-band remote writes found by flushes and fills, and conflicts resolved by overwrite or discard, per hour.

panels.title: Unsatisfied placement policies
panels.description: Buckets the cluster does not satisfy, and their shards short of separate failure domains, as the coordinator judges them.

panels.title: Fragment moves
panels.description: Fragments moved per hour to drain nodes, respect a failure domain's cap, or balance nodes (design section 8.3).

panels.title: Control store live
panels.description: 1 once the node has read the control store since it started; 0 while it serves its local copy.

panels.title: Since the last control-store read
panels.description: Time since each node last read the control store (SkyS3ControlStoreUnreachable).

panels.title: Identity copy age
panels.description: Age of each node's identity copy against identity_max_staleness, past which STS issues no new sessions.

panels.title: Unrepaired fragments
panels.description: Fragments known lost and not repaired yet, and the age of the oldest (design section 8.6).

panels.title: Oldest unrepaired fragment
panels.description: How long the oldest lost fragment has waited for repair.

panels.title: Repairs
panels.description: Fragments rebuilt per hour, and the bytes repairs and moves read and wrote per second.

panels.title: Repair time
panels.description: Time from finding a fragment lost to its relocation committing.

panels.title: Compaction
panels.description: Bytes of log segments reclaimed and of records copied, per second (design section 10.3).

panels.title: Compaction write amplification
panels.description: Bytes the logs wrote over those written for anything but compaction's copies.

panels.title: Lifecycle
panels.description: Object versions expired and multipart uploads aborted by lifecycle rules, per hour (design section 8.7).

panels.title: Segments reclaimed
panels.description: Log segments compaction reclaimed per hour.

panels.title: Clean cache
panels.description: Clean payload each node keeps as cache, against its limit (design section 9.3).

panels.title: Evictions and fills
panels.description: Clean payloads evicted, by the cache and by compaction, and evicted versions filled from the remote, per second.

panels.title: Hot cache hit ratio
panels.description: GETs served from the hot cache over hot-cache lookups (design section 9.2).

panels.title: Hot cache
panels.description: Bytes the hot cache holds and reserves for fills, and its evictions per second.

panels.title: Flush concurrency
panels.description: The requests the flushers may have in flight per bucket: the adaptive window (design section 7.7).

panels.title: Flush bytes in flight
panels.description: Bytes the flushers hold in memory for requests to each bucket's target.

panels.title: Target base round trip
panels.description: The smallest mean latency of a round of flush requests, per bucket's target.

panels.title: Throttles
panels.description: Flush requests the target answered with a throttle, per second.

panels.title: Flush transport
panels.description: The transport the flushers of each bucket whose target is a peer SkyS3 cluster use: 1 for QUIC or S3 REST. S3 REST under target_transport = auto means the native transport fell back, for example because UDP is blocked.

panels.title: Admin requests
panels.description: Requests answered by the admin listener per second, by endpoint and status code; 401 counts rejected callers.
